Our client, located in the Beveren region, is looking for a Supervisor Piping & Mechanical with strong technical expertise and people leadership skills.
 
 

• You’ll lead, coordinate and supervise daily piping and mechanical maintenance activities with a strong focus on HSE, quality, cost control and operational continuity 

• You’ll plan, prioritize and allocate maintenance work to ensure efficient execution of both preventive and corrective maintenance activities 

• You’ll organize daily toolbox meetings, communicate priorities and ensure compliance with all safety procedures and permit-to-work requirements 

• You’ll actively supervise field activities and provide technical support to technicians and contractors during the execution of maintenance work 

• You’ll coordinate closely with Operations, Engineering, Reliability and Inspection departments to align maintenance priorities and ensure efficient plant availability 

• You’ll ensure the safe and efficient execution of maintenance activities on piping systems, pressure vessels, heat exchangers, storage tanks and other static equipment 

• You’ll safeguard the mechanical integrity of plant assets by ensuring that maintenance and repair activities are executed according to engineering standards, site procedures and applicable regulations 

• You’ll support inspection programs and follow up on findings, integrity assessments, statutory inspections and corrective actions 

• You’ll coordinate and manage external contractors, ensuring compliance with safety, quality, planning and budget requirements 

• You’ll monitor work quality and verify that repairs, modifications and installations are completed according to specifications and industry standards 

• You’ll support the preparation, execution and evaluation of shutdowns, turnarounds and maintenance projects 

• You’ll drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on reliability, safety, efficiency and maintenance performance 

• You’ll ensure accurate maintenance administration and reporting in SAP, including work order completion, time registration and maintenance history 
 

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical qualification, or equivalent by experience 

• You have at least 5 years of relevant maintenance experience within the petrochemical, chemical, oil & gas or related process industry 

• You’re experienced in a supervisory, team leader or coordination role within an industrial environment 

• You have solid knowledge of piping systems, pressure equipment, heat exchangers, storage tanks and other static equipment 

• You have a good understanding of mechanical integrity principles, inspection methodologies and reliability-driven maintenance practices 

• You have a strong knowledge of HSE requirements, permit-to-work systems, contractor management and process safety 

• You’re experienced with SAP or another CMMS system and good proficiency in Microsoft Office applications 

• You own strong planning, organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to effectively manage changing priorities 

• You have excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, enabling effective collaboration across multiple disciplines 

• You are fluent in Dutch and have a good command of English 

• You have a hands-on leadership style with the ability to motivate, coach and develop people

Historically recognized as the global benchmark for premium retail equipment and trolley manufacturing, 
Wanzl has successfully evolved into a 
total solutions provider optimizing customer experiences.
 

To support the ambitious course in Belgium and Luxembourg, Wanzl is looking for an entrepreunerial Business Development Manager.  This role is pivotal in driving the new era, turning premium product innovations and digital solutions into sustainable market share.
 

As Business Development Manager, you act as 'co-architect' of the business transformation in BeLux, supporting the General Manager. You combine traditional sales with high-level strategic business development to gain market share with new, digital, and automated solutions. You pioneer new growth areas while further expanding existing strategic partnerships.
 
 

• You further design and implement a sustainable go-to-market strategy to successfully position the renewed Wanzl portfolio in the market. 

• You take responsibility for major, existing key accounts in retail and proactively expand the C-level relationship network within complex Decision Making Units. 

• You actively identify market opportunities for product innovations (such as digital retail and automation solutions) and lead the acquisition process from A to Z, including complex price negotiations. 

• You implement structured and data-driven sales management (CRM, forecasting, and account planning) to achieve commercial performance and strict P&L and margin targets. 

• You work closely with the local sales and operational teams and the international headquarters to guarantee an optimal customer journey and efficient collaboration. 
 

• You hold a university degree and have 10 to 15 years of proven successful B2B sales and business development experience, preferably in retail or other relevant sector. 

• You are accustomed to operating in highly competitive markets and have experience managing complex key accounts. 

• You combine a strong commercial and entrepreneurial mindset with analytical skills and a P&L and margin focus, capable of translating data into concrete actions. 

• You have a proactive hands-on mentality and enjoy taking independent initiative to drive the business forward. 

• You communicate convincingly at various levels and are fluent in Dutch and French (required for the local market), as well as English (communications with HQ and other affiliates). Knowledge of German is a nice plus.

For a family-run company in the tyre sector, we are looking for an experienced tyre fitter to join the branch in Zottegem.

Our client works for cars, trucks, agriculture and industry, and runs several branches across Belgium.

Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?
 
• You fit, repair and balance tyres. Plenty of trucks and agricultural vehicles, so proper work with heavy equipment. 
• You work cleanly and safely. A wheel that is not perfectly secured is never an option. 
• You step in wherever you are needed. In a small team, everyone pitches in. 
• After six months to a year, once you know the job inside out, you also join roadside call-outs. The employer pays for the training and your category C licence.
 
• Experience as a tyre fitter. By far the most important point on this list. 
• A category B driving licence. 
• Dutch or English is enough. If French is your main language, we do need a basic level of English on top of it so you can work smoothly with the team. No need to be fluent. 
• Someone who is punctual, gets stuck in and takes safety seriously. 
• The ambition to build something long term with one employer.

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

Our client is a leading international law firm with a strong reputation for excellence and a collaborative working environment. To support its Brussels office, the firm is looking for a highly organised and proactive Legal Secretary.

Jobomschrijving

As a Legal Secretary, you will provide comprehensive administrative support to a team of lawyers and contribute to the smooth running of the office. Your responsibilities will include:

• Agenda management, organisation of meetings en events.
• Coordinating travel arrangements.
• Handling calls, emails and correspondence.
• Preparing, formatting and proofreading legal documents, presentations, reports and correspondence.
• Supporting billing processes and expense reporting.
• Working closely with colleagues across the Brussels and international offices to ensure seamless support.

• You have at least 2 years of experience in an administrative, Legal Assistant, Management Assistant or Executive Assistant role.
• Experience within a legal or professional services environment is an asset.
• You are fluent in English, French is a plus
• You have excellent organisational skills and strong attention to detail.
• You can manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a high level of accuracy and professionalism.
• You are proactive, adaptable and able to work both independently and as part of a team.

You will spend around 90% of your time in the field. Working with a colleague, you will carry out maintenance, inspections and technical interventions on specialised installations in the rail environment. Most assignments are in Antwerp, Brussels and Ghent, with additional interventions elsewhere. 
 
• Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on technical installations. 
• Analyse and resolve mechanical, electromechanical and electrical faults. 
• Assess technical situations independently and help determine the appropriate course of action. 
• Carry out measurements, inspections and interventions using professional tools and test equipment. 
• Liaise with colleagues, engineers and project managers. 
• Depending on your experience, coordinate activities and take a leading role in the field.  
Rail experience is an advantage, but not essential. You bring a solid technical background and relevant practical experience; Buhlmann will teach you the specific installations, procedures and safety requirements of the rail environment. Experience in industrial maintenance, machine building, installation engineering or field service can be highly relevant.
 
After your induction period, you will take part in the on-call rota. Urgent night-time interventions are limited to a few occasions per year. In addition, there is on average around one planned night intervention per month, with time off in lieu afterwards.

We are looking for an experienced technician who knows the trade, can tackle technical problems independently and takes responsibility for safe, high-quality execution. 
 
• Technical qualification in electromechanics, mechanics, electricity, or equivalent experience. 
• Several years of relevant practical experience in maintenance, industrial installations, machine building, field service or a comparable technical environment. 
• Strong foundation in mechanics and electromechanics, complemented by sufficient electrical knowledge. 
• You analyse problems methodically, work independently and consult others when the situation requires it. 
• You enjoy field work and are comfortable in a role involving travel to different sites. 
• Experience as a lead technician, team leader or site supervisor is an advantage; even in such a role, you still want to remain technically involved. 
• You can communicate operationally in Dutch and/or French and have sufficient English for technical communication.

jobs.occupation: Administrative Officer - Technical Sales Support & Logistics
jobs.description:
Navision, order processing and follow-up form the core of the role – but the position is clearly broader than traditional order administration. 

As Administrative Officer – Technical Sales Support & Logistics, you are a key link between customers, suppliers and your colleagues. As you gain experience, you can also become more involved in logistics follow-up and the administrative support of technical projects.
  
• Process and follow up customer orders in Microsoft Dynamics Navision. 
• Prepare quotations, order confirmations and purchase orders. 
• Place orders with suppliers and actively follow up delivery dates. 
• Support customers with questions about parts, spare parts and service. 
• Request prices and quotations from suppliers. 
• Follow up transport, deliveries, incoming goods and stock information. 
• Work closely with sales, project managers, engineers and technicians. 
• Occasionally provide practical support with a delivery or in the warehouse.  
The practical logistics component is limited – around 5 to 10% of the role – but it reflects the way Buhlmann works: colleagues do not constantly draw a line around where one job description ends and another begins.
 
Once you know the organisation well, your responsibilities can expand towards project support, for example project files in SharePoint, material orders, delivery follow-up and administrative preparation for invoicing.

Above all, we are looking for someone who is administratively strong, takes responsibility and shows initiative. 

You preferably have relevant experience in order administration, purchasing, sales support, customer service, logistics administration or a technical sales support role. You do not need to be a technical specialist, but an interest in a technical environment is important.
  
• Experience with an ERP system; knowledge of Navision is a strong advantage. SAP or a comparable system also provides a good basis. 
• You work accurately and in a structured way and can keep several files, deliveries and deadlines under control at the same time. 
• You take initiative: if a supplier needs to be chased or a file needs further investigation, you do not simply wait. 
• You are collegial and practically minded and do not mind occasionally helping with a delivery. 
• You are fluent in Dutch and can communicate professionally in English. French is a clear advantage; German is a welcome extra.

You will work closely with one or several Client Relationship Managers and play a key role in ensuring excellent service delivery to clients.

Your responsibilities as Client Administration Officer

As a Client Administration Officer, you will provide comprehensive administrative support while ensuring a high level of service to both clients and internal stakeholders.

Administrative & Executive Support

• Managing complex agendas and coordinating meetings
• Screening and handling calls, emails, and correspondence
• Welcoming clients and visitors
• Organizing meeting rooms and coordinating logistics
• Preparing presentations and administrative documentation
• Managing and maintaining client files and archives
• Ensuring smooth communication between clients, advisors, and internal teams
• Maintaining and updating client information in internal databases
Client & Financial Administration

• Supporting the opening of bank accounts in coordination with Compliance
• Following up on investment-related administrative processes
• Processing and monitoring financial transactions and investment orders
• Preparing reports, dashboards, and administrative analyses
• Ensuring accurate and compliant client documentation
• Supporting advisors in the day-to-day management of client relationships

Your profile as Client Administration Officer

• Bachelor in Office Management, Management Assistant, or equivalent experience
• Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar administrative support role
• Experience within a professional services environment (financial services, consulting, legal, wealth management, etc.) is a strong asset
• Excellent knowledge of Dutch, with a good command of French and English
• Strong administrative and organizational skills
• Affinity with numbers and financial environments
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently
• Strong attention to detail and accuracy
• Service-oriented, proactive, and solution-driven mindset
• High level of discretion and professionalism
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
• Experience with CRM systems or databases is an asset

Our client is a distinguished leader in the fine watch and luxury industry, renowned for craftsmanship and timeless excellence.
They are now looking for a driven Sales Executive Benelux, capable of elevating their commercial network and fostering long-term relationships.

jobs.occupation: Expert Service Delivery Manager – SIAM & ITIL
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Manage end-to-end service delivery within the assigned functional or technical domain.
• Act as the primary point of contact for service delivery follow-up towards various stakeholders.
• Coordinate collaboration and synergy between multiple internal and external service providers.
• Monitor service levels, performance, risks, issues, and escalations to ensure stability.
• Organize and chair operational and tactical consultation meetings, such as service reviews and coordination boards.
• Track incidents, structural problems, changes, and improvement actions from a service perspective.
• Provide consistent reporting on service performance and contribute to the professionalization of SIAM processes.

Requirements

• You possess 8+ years of experience in IT Service Management and ITIL.
• You have 5+ years of experience in Service Delivery Management, specifically in KPI and SLA monitoring.
• You bring 5+ years of experience in Multi-provider governance and coordination.
• You have 3+ years of experience with SIAM (Service Integration and Management).
• You possess experience in Escalation Management and Risk Management within service delivery.
• You bring experience with Service Reporting and governance structures.
• You have experience working within a government or public sector environment.
• You are proactive, result-oriented, and possess strong stakeholder management skills.

• Willingness to obtain additional certifications in service integration.

jobs.occupation: Senior Program Manager – Traffic & Incident Management Systems
jobs.description:

• You have 8+ years of experience in IT project and program management.
• You bring 2+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or Functional Analyst.
• You possess 1+ year of experience with traffic management or incident management systems within operational environments such as railway, aviation, or logistics.
• You're experienced in coordinating multiple interdependent workstreams and managing program-level governance.
• You have a proven track record in budget forecasting, financial reporting, and resource management.
• You possess a Master’s degree in IT, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
• You are proactive, solution-oriented, and capable of managing complex stakeholder relationships.
• You are fluent in English with professional proficiency in French or Dutch.

• Experience managing large-scale vendor relationships and external technical suppliers.

jobs.occupation: Expert Program Manager – Microsoft E5 & Security
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Coordinate the planning and execution of the full Microsoft E5 suite rollout across the organization.
• Monitor progress and dependencies while ensuring technical alignment with internal ICT departments.
• Identify risks, bottlenecks, and security challenges to propose effective mitigation strategies.
• Oversee configuration, governance, and identity management within the cloud environment.
• Manage relationships with external vendors and key stakeholders to ensure smooth project adoption.
• Document technical decisions and report progress regularly to the Chief Information Security Officer.

Requirements

• 8+ years in program or project management with a focus on Cybersecurity and Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC).
• Extensive experience with Microsoft 365 E5 services including Exchange, Teams, and SharePoint.
• Deep knowledge of identity and access management using Entra ID (Azure AD), MFA, and Conditional Access.
• Strong expertise in endpoint management and cloud solutions with Microsoft Intune.
• You have a solid understanding of NIS 2 and GDPR compliance frameworks.
• You bring experience in license management and vendor coordination with Microsoft resellers.
• You possess a Bachelor or Master degree in Information Systems or a related technical field.
• You're an effective communicator capable of bridging the gap between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders.
• You are fluent in English with active knowledge of Dutch or French.
Nice to Haves

• Possession of relevant Microsoft certifications.
• Familiarity with legacy infrastructure such as ADFS, SCCM, or on-premise Active Directory.

jobs.occupation: IAM Support Engineer – Azure & Entra ID
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Resolve incidents, information requests, and service applications within the security, privacy, and identity management domains.
• Manage the technical and administrative aspects of onboarding and offboarding processes for various clients.
• Implement and monitor changes within the infrastructure and account management teams.
• Develop and maintain security and privacy policies, standards, procedures, and operational guidelines.
• Collaborate with stakeholders and internal teams to provide technical support and ensure security compliance.
• Contribute actively to the transition from current ITSM tools to a new service management platform.

Requirements

• You possess a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent through experience.
• You bring 3+ years of experience in the technical configuration and management of Microsoft Azure.
• You have 3+ years of experience with Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD), including advanced technical configuration beyond basic user administration.
• You possess 3+ years of experience in IT Networking, specifically with IP addressing, subnets, firewalls, routing, and DNS.
• You have proven experience in drafting, monitoring, and executing technical or operational processes and ITIL guidelines.
• You bring experience with Microsoft Entra components such as Privileged Identity Manager, Identity Governance, and Domain Services.
• You're proactive and able to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
• You are fluent in English with C1 level proficiency in either Dutch or French.
Nice to Haves

• Experience within the energy market.
• 3+ years of experience with Office 365.
• Working knowledge of ServiceNow or TOPdesk.
• Relevant certifications such as MS-500, AZ-500, SC-100, SC-300, or SC-900.
• Active knowledge of both Dutch and French.

Responsibilities

• Architect and optimize Python-based software applications for core business activities.
• Collaborate with stakeholders to define technical specifications and gather requirements.
• Implement best practices for code quality, testing, and CI/CD pipelines.
• Mentor team members through code reviews and technical leadership.
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues within the monitoring and alerting engines.
• Ensure the security, scalability, and maintainability of event-driven solutions.

Requirements

• 6+ years of experience in software development.
• 3+ years of expertise in backend development with Python, FastAPI, and Pydantic.
• You possess strong experience with AsyncIO.
• You have a solid background in data and integration using SQL, specifically MSSQL or PostgreSQL.
• You bring experience with message brokers such as RabbitMQ.
• You possess deep knowledge of service-based architectures and event-driven systems.
• You have a strong understanding of software design patterns, data structures, and algorithms.
• You're experienced in implementing IT security requirements within critical infrastructure environments.
• You bring experience working in Agile environments and have a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
• You are fluent in English with a good level of Dutch and/or French.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with Azure cloud services.
• Knowledge of NoSQL solutions and test automation frameworks like Selenium.
• Familiarity with containerization using Docker and CI/CD deployment pipelines.
• Experience with legacy code refactoring initiatives.
• Proficiency in German.

Responsibilities

• Capture business requirements and translate them into detailed functional analyses and technical designs.
• Document existing and new functionalities through reverse engineering and specification drafting.
• Provide application support including bug fixing, incident management, and user assistance for various platforms.
• Collaborate with stakeholders to define test scenarios and support business acceptance testing.
• Participate in workshops to advise on technical components and potential risks regarding industry standards.
• Manage change and release processes in alignment with internal project methodologies.

Requirements

• 5+ years experience as a Functional Analyst.
• 5+ years experience in application support, including incident management, releases, and monitoring.
• 1+ year experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.
• 1+ year experience in the utilities sector specifically focused on energy supply.
• 1+ year experience with energy market communication standards such as MIG6 or MIG DGO.
• 1+ year experience working with Agile and Scrum methodologies.
• 1+ year experience using JIRA for project tracking and ticket management.
• Experience with ITIL change and release management processes.
• Experience writing and splitting user stories and leading refinement sessions.
• You are proactive, solution-oriented, and possess strong diplomatic communication skills.
• You are fluent in Dutch at a C2 level with active knowledge of English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with project methodologies.
• Experience writing test scenarios.
• Ability to read and understand .Net code.

jobs.occupation: Senior Program Manager – Software Delivery & Planning Systems
jobs.description:
